financial_basis: Q3 10-Q throughSep30, common shares cover asofOct21, TTM revenue/EBIT throughSep30; future periods remain analyst scenarios, not new management guidance or fully reconciled TPU segment forecasts.
units: USD billions and billion current common shares; per-share prices USD

accounting_policy.sbc: Retained in EBIT as an economic operating cost; never added back. Hold current share count, with an extra 10% dilution sensitivity separately.
accounting_policy.leases: Operating rental cash cost retained in EBIT; operating lease debt is not separately deducted. Forecast capex includes cash and future financed asset purchases; finance lease debt deducted, principal is not an extra operating outflow.
accounting_policy.preferred: Deduct liquidation preference as claim-value proxy, exclude conversion shares; not both claim and if-converted share count. Future preferred coupons included in this claim-value approximation, not separately deducted again.
accounting_policy.investments: Investment income excluded from EBIT; mark-date/tax/liquidity haircut applied to investment assets, without another full deferred-tax subtraction.
accounting_policy.working_capital: Baseline2%of incremental revenue preserved only to isolate updated financial facts;5%/10%stresses run separately. No duplicate capex/inventory charge. Future cash release scenarios are separate, not baseDCF addbacks.
accounting_policy.terminal: Years6–10 revenue growth fades linearly from growth_next5 to terminal_growth. FCFF11=NOPAT10*(1+g)*(1-g/ROIC). Capex year10 uses actual year10 growth, which now equals terminal growth; no terminal reinvestment discontinuity.
accounting_policy.assumptions: All growth, margins, taxes, capex, D&A, discount/terminal rates, reserve, retention factors and scenario bands below are analyst assumptions, not management guidance or probability estimates.

update_limitations: All three growth/margin/capex/D&A/tax/WACC/terminalROIC/retention assumptions preserved fromOct28; no numerical2027 company capex guidance fabricated
